title: Research sprint goal: The next pool benchmark record runs as one capped command on trustworthy measurements

Three pack a false good (no cited line answers) and are gaps, answered from the live docs and written as kb facts through /kb-refresh: (1) Claude Opus 5.5's input, output, cache-write and cache-read prices per MTok; (2) Claude Sonnet 5's output price per MTok (with its other prices if the kb lacks them); (3) the Claude Code version from which the sonnet alias resolves to Sonnet 5.5 (bench_core.ALIAS uses 2.1.284 from the benchmark history; a changelog or release note is the source), or a gap entry naming what was tried. These are the kb lines bench_core.PRICE and ALIAS then cite.
notes: Packed on 2026-10-08 with rag.py pack -q over five questions: Q1 claude -p usage fields good (ci-and-headless.md:77 modelUsage outputTokens); Q2 Opus 5.5 output price, Q3 sonnet alias version, Q5 Sonnet 5 output price false good (no line states them); Q4 Opus 5.5 effort good.
